body.x: Polaroid participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced a Polaroid camera with modern design ‘OneStep2' and 'POP’.

Polaroid's OneStep2 is a new Polaroid camera that blends classical design with modern style. This product inspired by the previous model, OneStep, is designed to make instant photos more conveniently. It is equipped with high-quality lenses and powerful flash for great pictures every time, and can take pictures at any time with a long lasting USB rechargeable battery.

Polaroid POP product is characterized with modern design. With a directive touch-screen display, 20MP pictures and 1080p, 720p HD video can be taken easily. Using Polaroid printing applications, standard-size pictures can be instantly printed, which enables to make more memories, and it gives users fun by decorating pictures with stickers and emoticons. It is equipped with a micro SD card slot supporting up to 128 GB of storage, a 3.97-inch touchscreen LCD, a 20-megapixel CMOS sensor, and built-in dual LED flash for high-quality image and image stabilization.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
